Flat orthographic asset, even neutral ambient light, NO baked cast shadows, NO glossy shading. Four sprays same scale but different asymmetrical silhouette. No scene, no captions, no border, no checkerboard background. Intended on existing gently curved 3D alpha-tested leaf cards with live light, not a whole tree render. Hand-painted minimalist Genshin-inspired foliage character, original artwork. Transparent alpha throughout all gaps, no detached dust or tiny fragments.
